name: Something To Watch
hint: Three takes. The walker patrols the floor between x=14 and x=30 and will not leave that span even while chasing, and the turret at the far right sweeps the floor from x=12 rightward. Note the walker locks onto whichever body it noticed and keeps chasing THAT one while it stays in range, which is what makes an Echo usable as bait. TAKE 1: walk right onto plate p1 (x=4..6) and stand there; this holds the turret offline. p1 is 8 units from the walker's left bound, just outside its 7-unit alert range, so nothing comes for you. End the take standing on it. TAKE 2: Echo A now holds p1. Hop up the step at x=9..11.2 (a 1.6 rise) then up onto the perch at x=12..14.6 (a 1.8 rise) and stand. The walker comes to its left bound at x=14 and stares up at you, but it is a ground unit and the perch is 3.6 units above the floor, so it cannot reach you. End the take on the perch. TAKE 3: Echo A holds the turret offline, Echo B stands on the perch and holds the walker pinned at x=14 for the whole take. Take the same climb, jump the 1.4-unit gap from the perch onto the ledge at x=16..28, run right along it above the walker's head, drop off its right end at x=28 onto the floor, and run to the exit at x=37 through a lane the turret can no longer fire down. Without the bait the walker roams as far as x=30 and meets you where you land.

dialogue.text: It sweeps the corridor. Patient. It has done this a long time.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: It cannot tell us apart. Give it one of us to follow.
Stand somewhere it can see you and never reach you. Then walk over it.
